diagnoses.description:
Long-running/unbounded OCR processing within the Excel-writing run (likely re-OCRing all images serially with expensive settings) caused the process to exceed the environment’s soft time limits and prevented reaching the save/close and validation steps.
Evidence: The Excel generation script never reaches a completion/verification point; repeated checks show “⏳ Process still running (soft timeout)” (Turn 31 observation; Turn 32 observation). No observation confirms that /app/workspace/stat_ocr.xlsx was written, that it contains exactly one sheet named “results”, or that rows match required ordering/format.
Trajectory location: turns 28–32

Lack of contingency handling for timeouts and absence of a strategy to reuse previously computed extraction results led to stalled progress and no final artifact confirmation.
Evidence: The agent only waits/checks again and receives continued soft timeouts; there is no fallback action such as reducing OCR workload, writing incrementally, caching prior OCR results from earlier validation runs, or verifying an already-created partial output file.
Trajectory location: turns 31–32

location_policy: native trajectory locations retained in description; no inferred Skill location
